One studio, from the site to the cushion.

Most homes and offices are shaped by several separate hands: an architect, an interior designer, a landscape consultant, and a contractor who tries to make them agree. At AKAR, these sit at one table. The building, the rooms inside it and the ground around it are designed together, so they read as one place.

Our work spans residential, commercial and public-sector projects. Warm timber, natural stone, soft light and generous planting run through it — calm spaces that are easy to live and work in, and built to last in our climate.

Selected work

Architecture

Independent homes, farm houses, villas and commercial buildings, planned around light, ventilation and how the family or team will actually use them.

Interior design

Complete interiors for apartments, villas and offices: layouts, joinery, kitchens, bathrooms, lighting, finishes and loose furniture.

Landscape

Courtyards, gardens, terraces and community landscapes, with planting palettes chosen for Bengaluru’s soil and seasons.

Urban and public spaces

Streetscapes, junctions, lakefronts and parks, drawing on our planning background and work with public bodies.

How a project moves through the studio

  1. Brief and siteWe listen, visit the site and agree on scope, budget and timeline.
  2. ConceptLayouts, mood and material direction, with 3D views to decide from.
  3. Detailed designWorking drawings, BOQs and a fixtures and finishes schedule.
  4. ExecutionSite coordination, vendor management and regular client updates.
  5. HandoverSnag checks, final walkthrough and a home or office ready to use.

Ar. Ashritha K

Principal Architect and Urban Planner

Ashritha founded AKAR after years of teaching architecture and urban planning, and still brings a teacher’s clarity to every client conversation. Her work centres on sustainable architecture, public space design and urban flood resilience.

She presented the paper Aquaphony: Symphony of Bengaluru’s Resilience at the 72nd National Town and Country Planners Conference.
